lideranca.title: Rotary leadership
presidenteClube.texto: Dr. Stefan Grube Kolb serves as president of the Rotary Club of Porto União – União da Vitória for the 2026-2027 Rotary year, leading the club under the theme "Create Lasting Impact".
governador.texto: Moacir Schaly and Maria Cristina Thibes Schaly, of the Rotary Club of Campos Novos (SC), are the Governor Couple of District 4740 for the 2026-2027 Rotary year. After years dedicated to volunteer work — Moacir served as president of his own club before taking on the district governorship — the couple travels across the region on Official Visits, encouraging new projects, strengthening fellowship among clubs, and supporting the volunteer work of Rotarians throughout the district.
presidente.texto: A lawyer and engineer, Olayinka Hakeem Babalola has been a member of the Rotary Club of Trans Amadi, Nigeria, since 1994 — after starting out in Rotaract in 1984. Over more than three decades in the organization, he served as district governor (2011-12), Rotary International vice president (2019-20), and a member of the RI Board of Directors (2018-20). With 25 years in the oil and gas industry, including senior roles at Shell, he also founded two companies of his own. In 2026-27, he becomes the second African to lead Rotary International, under the theme "Create Lasting Impact".
